text_en: The Lord spoke to Moses on Mount Sinai, saying:
text_cn: 上主在西乃山训示梅瑟说：

text_en: Speak to the people of Israel and say to them: When you enter the land that I am giving you, the land shall observe a sabbath for the Lord .
text_cn: “你告诉以色列子民说：几时你们进入了我要赐给你们的地方，这地方将为上主守安息。

text_en: Six years you shall sow your field, and six years you shall prune your vineyard, and gather in their yield;
text_cn: 六年之内，你可播种田地；六年之内，你可修剪葡萄园，收获其中的出产。

text_en: but in the seventh year there shall be a sabbath of complete rest for the land, a sabbath for the Lord : you shall not sow your field or prune your vineyard.
text_cn: 但到第七年，地应完全休息，是上主的安息年。你不可播种田地，也不可剪修葡萄园；

text_en: You shall not reap the aftergrowth of your harvest or gather the grapes of your unpruned vine: it shall be a year of complete rest for the land.
text_cn: 连你收获后而自然生出的，你也不可收割；葡萄树未加修剪而结的葡萄，你也不可采摘；是地完全休息的一年。

text_en: You may eat what the land yields during its sabbath—you, your male and female slaves, your hired and your bound laborers who live with you;
text_cn: 地在休息期而自然生出的，可供给你们吃：即供给你、你的仆婢、佣工和与你同住的客人吃。

text_en: for your livestock also, and for the wild animals in your land all its yield shall be for food.
text_cn: 地自然生的，也可供给你的牲畜和你地中的走兽吃。

text_en: You shall count off seven weeks of years, seven times seven years, so that the period of seven weeks of years gives forty-nine years.
text_cn: 你应计算七个安息年，即七乘七年；七个安息年的时期，正是四十九年。

text_en: Then you shall have the trumpet sounded loud; on the tenth day of the seventh month—on the day of atonement—you shall have the trumpet sounded throughout all your land.
text_cn: 这年七月初十，你应吹号角，即在赎罪节日，你们应在全国内吹起号角，

text_en: And you shall hallow the fiftieth year and you shall proclaim liberty throughout the land to all its inhabitants. It shall be a jubilee for you: you shall return, every one of you, to your property and every one of you to your family.
text_cn: 祝圣第五十年，向全国居民宣布自由；为你们是一喜年，人各归其祖业，人各返其家庭。

text_en: That fiftieth year shall be a jubilee for you: you shall not sow, or reap the aftergrowth, or harvest the unpruned vines.
text_cn: 第五十年为你们是一喜年，不可播种；自然生出的，不可收获；葡萄树未加修剪而结的葡萄，不可采摘，

text_en: For it is a jubilee; it shall be holy to you: you shall eat only what the field itself produces.
text_cn: 因为这是喜年，为你们应是圣年；你们只可吃田地自然生的。

text_en: In this year of jubilee you shall return, every one of you, to your property.
text_cn: 在这喜年内，人各归其祖业。

text_en: When you make a sale to your neighbor or buy from your neighbor, you shall not cheat one another.
text_cn: 为此，如你卖给你的同胞产业，或由你的同胞购买，你们不可彼此欺压；

text_en: When you buy from your neighbor, you shall pay only for the number of years since the jubilee; the seller shall charge you only for the remaining crop years.
text_cn: 你应照上次喜年后的年数由你同胞购买，他应照收获的年数卖给你。

text_en: If the years are more, you shall increase the price, and if the years are fewer, you shall diminish the price; for it is a certain number of harvests that are being sold to you.
text_cn: 年数越多，你越应多付买价；年数越少，越应少付买价，因为他卖给你的是物产的数目。

text_en: You shall not cheat one another, but you shall fear your God; for I am the Lord your God.
text_cn: 为此，你们不可彼此欺压，但应敬畏你的天主，因为我上主是你们的天主。

text_en: You shall observe my statutes and faithfully keep my ordinances, so that you may live on the land securely.
text_cn: 你们应遵行我的法令，遵守我的规定，一一依照执行，好叫你们平安地住在这地上，

text_en: The land will yield its fruit, and you will eat your fill and live on it securely.
text_cn: 地必供给出产，使你们吃饱，平安住在地上。

text_en: Should you ask, “What shall we eat in the seventh year, if we may not sow or gather in our crop? ”
text_cn: 若你们追问说：到第七年，我们若不能播种，又不能收集我们的出产，我们吃什么？

text_en: I will order my blessing for you in the sixth year, so that it will yield a crop for three years.
text_cn: 在第六年上，我必决定祝福你们，叫地有三年的出产；

text_en: When you sow in the eighth year, you will be eating from the old crop; until the ninth year, when its produce comes in, you shall eat the old.
text_cn: 你们在第八年上播种时，还吃陈粮；直到第九年，直到收割新粮时，还有陈粮吃。

text_en: The land shall not be sold in perpetuity, for the land is mine; with me you are but aliens and tenants.
text_cn: 土地不可出卖而无收回权，因为地是我的，你们为我只是旅客或住客。

text_en: Throughout the land that you hold, you shall provide for the redemption of the land.
text_cn: 对你们所占的各地，应承认地有赎回权。

text_en: If anyone of your kin falls into difficulty and sells a piece of property, then the next of kin shall come and redeem what the relative has sold.
text_cn: 如果你的兄弟贫穷，卖了一份家产，他的至亲可来作代赎人，赎回他兄弟所卖的家产。

text_en: If the person has no one to redeem it, but then prospers and finds sufficient means to do so,
text_cn: 人若没有代赎人，几时自己富足了，有了足够的赎价，

text_en: the years since its sale shall be computed and the difference shall be refunded to the person to whom it was sold, and the property shall be returned.
text_cn: 当计算卖出后的年数，将差额还给买主，收回自己的家产。

text_en: But if there are not sufficient means to recover it, what was sold shall remain with the purchaser until the year of jubilee; in the jubilee it shall be released, and the property shall be returned.
text_cn: 如果他无法获得足够的赎价，他所卖的，应存于买主之手直到喜年；到了喜年，地应退还，卖主收回自己的家产。

text_en: If anyone sells a dwelling house in a walled city, it may be redeemed until a year has elapsed since its sale; the right of redemption shall be one year.
text_cn: 若人卖了一所在城墙内的住宅，自卖出后，一年内，他有赎回的权利；他赎回的权利为期一年。

text_en: If it is not redeemed before a full year has elapsed, a house that is in a walled city shall pass in perpetuity to the purchaser, throughout the generations; it shall not be released in the jubilee.
text_cn: 如果满了一年，他没有赎回，在城墙内的房屋应归买主与其后代，再无收回权；即使到了喜年，亦不应退还。

text_en: But houses in villages that have no walls around them shall be classed as open country; they may be redeemed, and they shall be released in the jubilee.
text_cn: 但房屋在没有围墙的村庄内，应算是田产，有赎回的权利；到了喜年应该退还。

text_en: As for the cities of the Levites, the Levites shall forever have the right of redemption of the houses in the cities belonging to them.
text_cn: 至于肋未人得为产业的城市中的房屋，肋未人永享有赎回权。

text_en: Such property as may be redeemed from the Levites—houses sold in a city belonging to them—shall be released in the jubilee; because the houses in the cities of the Levites are their possession among the people of Israel.
text_cn: 如一肋未人在他得为产业的城市出卖的房屋，没有赎回，在喜年仍可收回，因为肋未城中的房屋，是他们在以色列子民中所得的不动产。

text_en: But the open land around their cities may not be sold; for that is their possession for all time.
text_cn: 但是，他们城外四郊之地，不可变卖，因为是永属他们的产业。

text_en: If any of your kin fall into difficulty and become dependent on you, you shall support them; they shall live with you as though resident aliens.
text_cn: 如果你的兄弟贫穷，无力向你还债，你应像待外方人或旅客一样扶持他，叫他能与你一起生活。

text_en: Do not take interest in advance or otherwise make a profit from them, but fear your God; let them live with you.
text_cn: 不应向他索取利息或重利，但应敬畏你的天主，让他与你一起生活，如你的兄弟。

text_en: You shall not lend them your money at interest taken in advance, or provide them food at a profit.
text_cn: 借给他银钱，不可取利息；借给他粮食，不可索重利。

text_en: I am the Lord your God, who brought you out of the land of Egypt, to give you the land of Canaan, to be your God.
text_cn: 我上主是你们的天主，我领你们离开埃及地，将客纳罕地赐给你们，是为做你们的天主。

text_en: If any who are dependent on you become so impoverished that they sell themselves to you, you shall not make them serve as slaves.
text_cn: 若你身旁的兄弟穷了，卖身给你，你不可迫他劳作如同奴隶一样；

text_en: They shall remain with you as hired or bound laborers. They shall serve with you until the year of the jubilee.
text_cn: 他在你身旁，应像佣工或外侨，给你工作直到喜年。

text_en: Then they and their children with them shall be free from your authority; they shall go back to their own family and return to their ancestral property.
text_cn: 那时，他和他的子女应离开你，回本家，复归其祖业；

text_en: For they are my servants, whom I brought out of the land of Egypt; they shall not be sold as slaves are sold.
text_cn: 因为他们是我的仆役，是我由埃及地领出来的；他们不能卖身，如同出卖奴隶。

text_en: You shall not rule over them with harshness, but shall fear your God.
text_cn: 你不可虐待他，但应敬畏你的天主。

text_en: As for the male and female slaves whom you may have, it is from the nations around you that you may acquire male and female slaves.
text_cn: 你需要的奴婢，应来自你们四周的民族，由他们中可购买奴婢。

text_en: You may also acquire them from among the aliens residing with you, and from their families that are with you, who have been born in your land; and they may be your property.
text_cn: 此外，可从同你们住在一起的外方人中，或从他们在你们境内所生的后代子孙中，购买奴婢。这些奴婢可成为你们的产业，

text_en: You may keep them as a possession for your children after you, for them to inherit as property. These you may treat as slaves, but as for your fellow Israelites, no one shall rule over the other with harshness.
text_cn: 可将他们留给你们的后代子孙，当作永久的产业，使他们劳作。至于你们的兄弟以色列子民，彼此既是兄弟，不可严加虐待。

text_en: If resident aliens among you prosper, and if any of your kin fall into difficulty with one of them and sell themselves to an alien, or to a branch of the alien’s family,
text_cn: 若外方人，或寄居在你处的人成了富翁，你的兄弟反而穷了，欠他的债，而卖身给寄居在你处的外方人，或外方人家中的后代；

text_en: after they have sold themselves they shall have the right of redemption; one of their brothers may redeem them,
text_cn: 卖身以后，仍享有赎回的权利；他的任何一个兄弟可以赎他；

text_en: or their uncle or their uncle’s son may redeem them, or anyone of their family who is of their own flesh may redeem them; or if they prosper they may redeem themselves.
text_cn: 他的叔伯，或他叔伯的儿子可以赎他；他家中的任何至亲骨肉都可以赎他；如他自己致富，亦可自赎。

text_en: They shall compute with the purchaser the total from the year when they sold themselves to the alien until the jubilee year; the price of the sale shall be applied to the number of years: the time they were with the owner shall be rated as the time of a hired laborer.
text_cn: 他应同购买自己的人，计算从卖身给他以后到喜年的年数；赎价应依照年数的多少，并按佣工每日的工价决定；

text_en: If many years remain, they shall pay for their redemption in proportion to the purchase price;
text_cn: 如剩下的年数尚多，他应依照年数的多少，出一部分赎价来赎身。

text_en: and if few years remain until the jubilee year, they shall compute thus: according to the years involved they shall make payment for their redemption.
text_cn: 如直到喜年剩下的年数不多，应这样计算：依照年数的比例交付赎价。

text_en: As a laborer hired by the year they shall be under the alien’s authority, who shall not, however, rule with harshness over them in your sight.
text_cn: 买主对他应像每年雇的工人；他不可当着你虐待那人。

text_en: And if they have not been redeemed in any of these ways, they and their children with them shall go free in the jubilee year.
text_cn: 如果那人不能这样赎身，到了喜年，他可与儿女自由离去。

text_en: For to me the people of Israel are servants; they are my servants whom I brought out from the land of Egypt: I am the Lord your God.
text_cn: 因为以色列子民只对我是奴隶，他们是我的奴隶，是我领他们离开了埃及地：我，上主是你们的天主。
